values.note: Standard site $28 a night, premium (RV) site $30, electric sites $35; $26 for a standard site in the September first-come season. Extra vehicle $8 a night. Long-term sites are sold by the month or season.

fees.source: recreation.gov campsite search (STANDARD NONELECTRIC price 28, RV NONELECTRIC 30, STANDARD ELECTRIC 35) + rates API 2027 seasons (Peak 2027-05-01 to 09-05: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28; Walk In 2027-09-06 to 09-30: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26) + FS page ('Standard: $28/night', 'Premium: $30/night', 'Electric: Available at some premium sites, additional $7 fee'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reservable May 1 to Sept 5, first come Sept 6-30 (recreation.gov 2027 rate seasons); the Forest Service page says May 1 - October 2.

season.source: recreation.gov rates API (2027 'Peak Season' 2027-05-01 to 2027-09-05, 'Walk In First-come, First-served Season' 2027-09-06 to 2027-09-30) + FS page ('Seasons of Use May 1 - October 2'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Long-term sites are reserved for the whole season through the project office. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon (FS).

note: Superior National Forest campground on Whiteface Reservoir (4,980 acres) near Aurora, in mixed aspen, birch and maple; a few sites overlook the water. Boat launch, fish-cleaning house, swim beach and playground; a group site and some long-term seasonal sites. --Claude
